label: Celebration & Occasion
description: The days people dress up for. Occasions rather than venues — a wedding is not a room, it is a reason everyone is in that room.

items.name: wedding-reception
items.text: A wedding reception in full swing, long tables under strung lights, a cake half-cut and confetti trodden into the floor.

items.name: wedding-ceremony-aisle
items.text: A ceremony aisle strewn with petals, ribboned chairs either side, an arch of flowers at the end and every head turned.

items.name: birthday-table
items.text: A birthday table crowded with mismatched plates, a lopsided homemade cake alight with candles and paper hats abandoned mid-meal.

items.name: new-year-countdown
items.text: A New Year countdown at the turn of the year, sparklers and raised glasses, streamers coming down and everyone looking the same way.

items.name: masquerade-ball
items.text: A masquerade ball in a mirrored hall, feathered and gilded masks, dancers turning under chandeliers and a quartet on a low dais.
items.text_short: masquerade ball in a mirrored hall

items.name: black-tie-gala
items.text: A black-tie gala at a long-tabled banquet, place cards and polished glassware, a lectern waiting and waiters moving between chairs.

items.name: carnival-parade
items.text: A carnival parade filling a street, feathered headdresses and drums, floats towering over a crowd pressed to the barriers.

items.name: graduation-lawn
items.text: A graduation on a college lawn, gowns and thrown caps against a clear sky, folding chairs in rows and families with cameras up.
items.text_short: graduation lawn, caps in the air

items.name: halloween-street
items.text: A Halloween street of carved pumpkins on porch steps, cobwebbed railings, costumed figures moving between pools of orange light.

items.name: christmas-market
items.text: A Christmas market of timber stalls and hot spiced steam, fairy lights strung overhead and a tree lit at the square's centre.

items.name: christmas-morning-room
items.text: A living room on Christmas morning, torn paper across a rug, a tree still lit and a fire going down to embers.
items.text_short: Christmas morning room, torn paper on the rug

items.name: street-festival
items.text: A street festival closed to traffic, bunting between balconies, food stalls smoking and a stage rigged at the far end.

items.name: harvest-fair
items.text: A harvest fair on stubble fields, trestle tables of produce, hay bales as seating and a marquee guyed against the wind.

items.name: fireworks-waterfront
items.text: A fireworks display over a waterfront, the crowd's faces lit in bursts, reflections breaking on the water and smoke drifting sideways.

items.name: engagement-dinner
items.text: An intimate engagement dinner, a small table dressed with candles and a single ring box, a bottle chilling and the room deliberately dim.
